PkmPage.heroTitle: Built openly, reported to the evidence.
PkmPage.heroBody: Gamblock-AI is a student prototype from Universitas Teknologi Yogyakarta combining local protection, a brief psychological pause, consent-based accountability, and self-regulation. This page separates connected implementation from external evaluation that is still pending.
PkmPage.methodTitle: Four layers working as one system
PkmPage.methodBody: Each layer has a distinct authority and data boundary. The website does not take over real-time detection or blocking.
PkmPage.method1Body: URL rules, title/heading/anchor text, Bag-of-Words, and Logistic Regression are processed on Android or Windows.
PkmPage.method2Body: A seven-second visual pause with reduced motion, offline grounding, and a recovery handoff that excludes the page address.
PkmPage.method3Body: A parent or peer helps review protection-removal requests without receiving history or private recovery details.
PkmPage.method4Body: Intentions, check-ins, education, missions, skills, and weekly evaluation form one coherent recovery step.
PkmPage.outputsBody: Drafts and production packages are ready for internal review. Public links will open only after real approvals, hashes, submission receipts, or publication records exist.
PkmPage.output1Body: A factual draft summarizes progress, risks, limitations, and the evaluation plan without unverified performance numbers.
PkmPage.output2Body: The complete structure is available; results remain gated on a Phase 4 evidence manifest with evaluated status.
PkmPage.output3Body: Android/Windows guidance, browser coverage, troubleshooting, limitations, a release record, and full requirement traceability are prepared.
PkmPage.output4Body: Instagram, Facebook, and TikTok are configured with an eight-week content plan; ownership and a publication archive still require evidence.
PkmPage.output5Body: A 2:45 script, storyboard, Indonesian/English captions, source register, and psychology, privacy, and accessibility checks are available.
PkmPage.output6Body: The manuscript draft includes method, evidence-state results, ethics, limitations, and references; supplier metrics do not replace Phase 4 results.
PkmPage.timeline1Body: Student needs, On-Device AI, Pattern Interrupt, accountability, and privacy were normalized into traceable requirements.
PkmPage.timeline2Body: Android, Windows, the passive extension, backend, and website are connected on the primary paths.
PkmPage.timeline3Body: Goals, monitoring, education, missions, skills, and weekly review form a loop instead of isolated widgets.
PkmPage.timeline4Body: Evaluators and instrumentation exist, but the dataset, devices, UTY cohort, ethics, and external review are incomplete.
PkmPage.timeline5Body: Reports, guidance, dissemination packages, the manuscript, and an evidence gate are ready for official team action.
PkmPage.timeline5Status: Local implementation complete · external acceptance pending
PkmPage.safeguard1: URLs, domains, DOM, history, screenshots, and page scores are not sent to the backend.
PkmPage.safeguard2: Partners see only consented status and aggregates, not browsing or private recovery content.
PkmPage.safeguard3: The Pattern Interrupt is not therapy, diagnosis, a cure, or proof of behavior change.
PkmPage.safeguard4: Research, partner relationships, product use, and media publication require separate consent.
PkmPage.limitation1Body: No dataset card, frozen split, education/government FPR, and reviewer currently satisfy the evaluation gate.
PkmPage.limitation2Body: Android and Windows do not yet have a reviewed device/VM matrix and final signed release.
PkmPage.limitation3Body: Retention is not yet academically defined and the Pattern Interrupt has no approved UTY cohort result.
PkmPage.limitation4Body: Coverage is limited to declared platforms and browsers; the prototype does not guarantee detection of all gambling content.
PkmPage.ctaTitle: Explore the product with full context.
PkmPage.ctaBody: Learn how On-Device AI works, check supported platforms, and read the data boundary before using the prototype.
